lists.name: Munros
lists.subtitle: Scottish 3000ft mountains
lists.criteria: Scottish mountains over 3000ft (914.4m) on the SMC's list of separate mountains.

lists.name: Munro Tops
lists.subtitle: Subsidiary 3000ft tops
lists.criteria: Subsidiary summits over 3000ft that are not separate Munros.

lists.name: Corbetts
lists.subtitle: Scottish 2500–3000ft hills
lists.criteria: Scottish hills between 2500ft and 3000ft with at least 500ft (152.4m) of drop on all sides.

lists.name: Fionas
lists.subtitle: Grahams: 2000–2500ft hills
lists.criteria: Scottish hills between 2000ft and 2500ft with at least 150m of drop, also known as Grahams.

lists.name: Donalds
lists.subtitle: Southern Uplands 2000ft hills
lists.criteria: Hills in the Scottish Lowlands of 2000ft or more, as listed by Percy Donald.

lists.name: Wainwrights
lists.subtitle: Lake District fells
lists.criteria: The 214 fells described in Alfred Wainwright's Pictorial Guides to the Lakeland Fells.

lists.name: Outlying Fells
lists.subtitle: Wainwright's Outlying Fells
lists.criteria: The summits from Wainwright's The Outlying Fells of Lakeland.

lists.name: Birketts
lists.subtitle: Lake District 1000ft+ hills
lists.criteria: Lake District hills of 1000ft or more, from Bill Birkett's Complete Lakeland Fells.

lists.name: Welsh 3000ers
lists.subtitle: The 15 Welsh 3000ft peaks
lists.criteria: The fifteen summits in Snowdonia/Eryri over 3000ft, traditionally done in one push.

lists.name: Furths
lists.subtitle: 3000ft peaks outside Scotland
lists.criteria: Mountains over 3000ft in England, Wales and Ireland: the Munros' 'furth'.

lists.name: Hewitts
lists.subtitle: England, Wales & Ireland 2000ft+
lists.criteria: Hills in England, Wales and Ireland over 2000ft with at least 30m of drop.

lists.name: Nuttalls
lists.subtitle: England & Wales 2000ft+
lists.criteria: Hills in England and Wales over 2000ft with at least 15m of drop.

lists.name: Marilyns
lists.subtitle: Hills with 150m prominence
lists.criteria: Hills of any height with at least 150m of drop on all sides.
